Trump Says 'You Should've Had Stock' to Build Net Worth. Here's How He's Increased His by Billions in His Second Term

In the two years since President Donald Trump was re-elected to the White House, his reported net worth has spiked by billions of dollars. Between 2024—during his presidential campaign—and 2025, Trump’s net worth rose from $4.3 billion to $7.3 billion, according to a Forbes report published in September 2025.
